typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

percentOpen.description: The {@link Feature} that represents the PERCENT_OPEN sensor instrumented on the Control Valve.

excludeFeatures.description:
Use this field to specify the list of columns in the input data that should be excluded from model training.

If any of the values specified in this list are not columns in the input data, the pipe will ignore them, and
will proceed with training and inference with the remaining features.

title:
This is an implementation of the {@link ControlValvesModelableMethods} interface. In this approach, if
the input data contains a feature for the PERCENT_OPEN {@link ExpectedSensor} instrumented on a Control Valve, a regressor
will be trained to reconstruct the {@link percentOpen} from the other features.


The risk score is computed as the absolute value of the residual (difference between the actual and reconstructed values of the
{@link percentOpen} feature).


Feature contributions are generated using SHAP, and scaled to sum up to the risk score. Note that in order to generate
feature contributions, the {@link ReliabilityRiskMl.Reconstruction.ControlValvesPipe#regressor} must be a tree
based model or a linear model.
name: ControlValvesModelableBase
